We demonstrate the effectiveness of Pat-ClaimEval through extensive experiments. Our results show that PatClaimEval achieves the highest correlation with human expert evaluations across all assessment criteria compared to existing metrics, including 6 N-gram-based methods, 4 embedding-based approaches, 2 multi-dimensional evaluators, and 1 LLM-as-a-judge method.
